newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rostelekom says lifts five pct share holding cap.
newsitem.headline: Rostelekom says lifts five pct share holding cap.

text.p: Russian long distance telecom company Rostelekom shareholders have lifted a five percent cap on individual shareholdings by approving a new charter in a mail-in vote, a Rostelekom spokesman said on Thursday.
"The new version of the charter does not have any limit on buying shares," the spokesman said. "The previous limit for a single shareholder was five percent of any type of Rostelekom shares."
Rostelekom investor relations official Nina Galova said that all issues on the mail-in agenda had been approved.
Shareholders were required to post their ballots for the mail-in annual meeting by July 18 and the full results are to be published at the end of this week in Izvestia newspaper, the company said.
